verdict.rationale: Hatchet's GitHub README claims the platform provides 'real-time monitoring, alerting, and logging,' and docs describe a TUI for real-time observability into tasks/workflows/workers, which speaks to internal visibility into failures and queue state. However, there is no evidence of exporting metrics (failure rates, latencies, queue depths) to external observability stacks like Prometheus/Grafana/Datadog, no documented metrics/export format, and no concrete alerting configuration (e.g., webhook/PagerDuty integration) — missing for 10: metrics export integration docs, alert-rule configuration, independent confirmation of alerting working in production.
